claims.text: Interactions (all diuretics): lithium—avoid, diuretics cut its clearance and risk toxicity;
claims.quote: Lithium generally should not be given with diuretics because they reduce lithium’s renal clearance and add a high risk of lithium toxicity.

claims.text: NSAIDs can blunt the diuretic and antihypertensive effect of loop, K-sparing and thiazide diuretics.
claims.quote: the administration of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agent can reduce the diuretic, natriuretic, and antihypertensive effects of loop, potassium-sparing and thiazide diuretics

claims.text: Overdose: supportive—replace fluid and electrolyte losses;
claims.quote: Treatment of overdosage is supportive and consists of replacement of excessive fluid and electrolyte losses.

claims.text: check electrolytes, carbon dioxide and BP often.
claims.quote: Serum electrolytes, carbon dioxide level and blood pressure should be determined frequently.
